answer: Because the nadir salt is published after the glacier checkpoint, the shale audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 227 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 186 keys hence forfeits for 186 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
